name: Mind Cross
source:
Join Rez and Psi as they get kidnapped by a mysterious figure. Trapped in a big blue box, they have no choice but to talk to each other to find a way out!

[From [url=https://critical-deluxe.itch.io/mind-cross-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与雷兹和Psi一起被神秘人物绑架。被困在一个蓝色的大盒子里，他们别无选择，只能互相交谈寻找出路！

[来自[url=https://critical-deluxe.itch.io/mind-cross-demo]itch.io[/url]]
